appliesCheckboxes.noSelectionMeansAll: Nothing selected = applies to all types

appliesPreview.hint: No selection in either field applies to all combinations; source without target type applies to source → all.

uriHelpPopover.title: Canonical URI
uriHelpPopover.description: The globally unique, persistent Linked Data URI of this concept in an authority database or thesaurus (e.g. Getty AAT, GND, or Nomisma).
uriHelpPopover.exportNote: Serves as a stable global identifier in RDF and Linked Data exports.

exactMatchUrisHelpPopover.title: Exact Match URIs (skos:exactMatch)
exactMatchUrisHelpPopover.description: External cross-concordances to equivalent concepts in other thesauri. Indicates that concepts from different vocabularies share the exact same meaning.
exactMatchUrisHelpPopover.separatorNote: Separate multiple URIs with commas or line breaks.

canonicalUriHelpPopover.title: Canonical Vocabulary URI / Namespace
canonicalUriHelpPopover.description: Base URI or namespace of the entire vocabulary or ConceptScheme (e.g. http://vocab.getty.edu/aat/). Term URIs typically relate to this scheme.

relationTypeHelp.heading: How the relation type is used
relationTypeHelp.description: “{{source}}” is the starting record, “{{target}}” the linked record. The label applies from Source → Target; the inverse direction shows the same connection from the Target.
relationTypeHelp.example: Example: "is part of" for Object → Occurrence; as inverse "has part" for Occurrence → Object.

importDialog.title: Import terms into "{{name}}"
importDialog.relationNotice: Relation types are flat. Without an ID column, the ID is derived automatically from the label.
importDialog.hierarchyNotice: Hierarchical lists: map one column to "Parent-ID". Without an ID column, the ID is derived from the label.
importDialog.acceptedFormats: CSV, TSV, JSON, SKOS (Turtle .ttl, RDF/XML .rdf, JSON-LD .jsonld)
importDialog.csvRequireTermOrLabel: Please map at least one column to 'ID' or 'Label'. Without an ID column, the ID is derived from the label.
importDialog.conceptSchemeHelp: e.g. http://vocab.getty.edu/aat/ (leave empty for entire file)
importDialog.topConceptHelp: e.g. http://vocab.getty.edu/aat/300000000 (only this concept and its descendants)
importDialog.maxDepthHelp: Limit hierarchy depth (e.g. 2 for root + direct children)
